integrity: Analytic Fubini and beta integral proof with a standalone deterministic exact-rational checker and independent ambient-rejection sampling diagnostics; finite verification is not the infinite-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact two-point product-order law applies to the full-dimensional complete positive-pair signed-order family in dimensions n>=2, not to all signed posets. Priority remains provisional; unindexed equivalent results may exist. No independent scientific audit has been completed.
title: Exact comparable-pair law and a half-mixed-stratum identity for a complete positive-root signed order polytope
